fs.writeFileSync('''.github/workflows/publish-source-networks.yml''',"name: Publish source networks
# A GITHUB_TOKEN-created release suppresses release events; the main CI completion also resolves its published tag.
on: # zizmor: ignore[dangerous-triggers]
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI/CD Pipeline"]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches-ignore: ['''e2e/**''']
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/publish-source-networks.yml"
      - "scripts/check-source-networks.mjs"
      - "scripts/verify-source-network-distribution.mjs"
      - "scripts/lib/source-network-packets.mjs"
      - "rust/tests/web/source-network-packets.test.mjs"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Run packet checks without publication
        type: choice
        options: [checks]
        default: checks
      pull-request:
        description: Pull request whose checks were dispatched
        type: string
        default: ''''''
      publish:
        description: Attach verified source packets to a published stable release (main only)
        type: boolean
        default: false
      tag:
        description: Published stable release tag (empty selects the latest)
        type: string
        default: ''''''
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: source-network-package-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  resolve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    if: >-
      github.event_name != '''workflow_run''' ||
      (github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == '''main''' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.event.workflow_run.conclusion != '''cancelled''' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.conclusion != '''skipped''')
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
      publish: ${{ steps.release.outputs.publish }}
      build: ${{ steps.release.outputs.build }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '''24.x'''
      - name: Resolve the published stable tag
        id: release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          REFERENCE: ${{ github.ref }}
          PUBLISH: ${{ inputs.publish }}
          INPUT_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
          RUN_HEAD: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          RUN_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
          RUN_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name }}
          RUN_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: node scripts/resolve-package-release.mjs
  packets:
    needs: resolve
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.resolve.outputs.build == '''true''' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Select the resolved published tag
        if: needs.resolve.outputs.tag != ''''''
        env:
          PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 1
          git fetch origin "refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG:refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG"
          git checkout --detach "refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '''24.x'''
      - name: Check out the shared pinned serializer
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          repository: link-foundation/meta-language
          ref: eb0574d5528babd3b4aadece81590d8e2230b99b
          path: .meta-language
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install serializer runtime dependencies
        run: npm ci --prefix .meta-language/js --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Produce complete lossless packets from the selected source commit
        env:
          SOURCE_SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
          PACKET_DIRECTORY: ${{ runner.temp }}/source-networks
          TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS: 600
          TEST_WARN_RATIO_PERCENT: 75
        run: |
          bash scripts/run-with-budget.sh source-networks-release \
            node scripts/check-source-networks.mjs --meta-language .meta-language \
            --shard-count 8 --shard-index "$SOURCE_SHARD" --write --output "$PACKET_DIRECTORY"
      - name: Bundle the complete shard with its receipts
        env:
          SOURCE_SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
          PACKET_DIRECTORY: ${{ runner.temp }}/source-networks
          ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY/formal-ai-source-networks-$SOURCE_SHARD.tar.gz" -C "$PACKET_DIRECTORY" .
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: formal-ai-source-networks-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/formal-ai-source-networks-${{ matrix.shard }}.tar.gz
          if-no-files-found: error
  attach:
    needs: [resolve, packets]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.resolve.outputs.publish == '''true''' && needs.packets.result == '''success''' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Select the resolved published tag
        env:
          PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 1
          git fetch origin "refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG:refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG"
          git checkout --detach "refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '''24.x'''
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: formal-ai-source-networks-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/source-network-archives
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Verify every shard against the published source commit
        env:
          ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY: ${{ runner.temp }}/source-network-archives
          DISTRIBUTION_DIRECTORY: ${{ runner.temp }}/source-network-distribution
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for shard in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do
            mkdir -p "$DISTRIBUTION_DIRECTORY/shard-$shard"
            tar -xzf "$ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY/formal-ai-source-networks-$shard.tar.gz" -C "$DISTRIBUTION_DIRECTORY/shard-$shard"
          done
          node scripts/verify-source-network-distribution.mjs "$DISTRIBUTION_DIRECTORY"
      - name: Attach all verified packets to the stable release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.tag }}
          ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY: ${{ runner.temp }}/source-network-archives
        run: gh release upload "$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG" "$ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY"/formal-ai-source-networks-*.tar.gz --clobber
");
